rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for being alone or unaccompanied, especially when no companion or instructor is present.

example.english: I went solo on the trip.
example.jyutping: ngo5 daan1 duk6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when someone does something without a companion.

example.english: I go to the movies solo.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 tai2 hei3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the person does it by themselves rather than with anyone else.

example.english: This time I did everything solo.
example.traditional: 今次我自己一個整晒啲嘢。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 zing2 saai3 di1 je5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for an instrumental solo piece or performance.

example.english: The solo in this song is hard to play.
example.traditional: 呢首歌嘅獨奏部分好難拉。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 duk6 zau3 bou6 fan6 hou2 naan4 laai1

rows.note: Use this when the one performer is singing rather than playing an instrument.

example.jyutping: aat3 zuk6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 duk6 coeng3

rows.note: Use this for a one-person theatrical act or show rather than an ordinary solo job.

example.english: That solo show tonight made me laugh so hard my stomach hurt.
example.traditional: 今晚嗰套獨腳戲笑到我肚痛。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 go2 tou3 duk6 gok3 hei3 siu3 dou3 ngo5 tou5 tung3

rows.jyutping: jat1 go3 jan4 zou6 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this productive noun construction for a job or task carried out by one person alone.

example.traditional: 呢個係一個人做嘅項目。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 jan4 zou6 ge3 hong6 muk6
